_what: Per-paper checks P1-P10 for lius_40500862. Each is an agreement count out of a stated denominator.

P1_hrms_ours_vs_si_calculated_ppm._what: Our independently assembled SMILES against the m/z the authors printed as 'calculated'. This is the comparison that tests OUR structure.

P2_hrms_si_found_vs_si_calculated_ppm._what: The authors' own internal consistency. Independent of us entirely, so a failure here is a published typo.
P2_hrms_si_found_vs_si_calculated_ppm._finding: All 10 of 10 residuals are POSITIVE with mean +4.8 ppm. That is a systematic instrument calibration offset, not scatter and not a typo: a transcription error would be a single large outlier of either sign. No published typo detected.

P3_hrms_ours_vs_si_found_ppm._what: Closes the triangle. Agreeing with the calculated value and with the found value are different statements.

P4_carbonate_minus_carboxylate_is_n_oxyg._what: THE LINKAGE CHECK THAT MASS CAN DO. Carbonate and its carboxylate counterpart differ by exactly one oxygen per tail. Mass still cannot see WHERE that oxygen sits -- P10 does that.

P5_axis_leave_one_out_tick_residual._what: axis.calibrate's max-residual test is weak against a SINGLE bad tick -- least squares drags the line toward the outlier. Reported as leave-one-out, which has no leverage masking.

P6_axis_rule_sits_on_the_extreme_tick._what: A round number the authors DREW and never printed: on every panel the x-axis rule is the lowest decade tick (1e4, 1e4, 1e4, 1e0) or the linear zero. Detected from the black rule, which took no part in the tick fit.
P6_axis_rule_sits_on_the_extreme_tick._earned_itself: This check found a real error on its first run: S22C's baseline had been taken as row 440 from a full-page dark-row scan, but row 440 is panel A's flow-cytometry box and panel C's rule is at 380, coinciding with its 1e4 tick. Error class 20. Fixed in stage01_values.py; all 23 values were unchanged, verified by diff.

P7_bar_top_left_right_flank_agreement._what: bars.bar_top's class-32 guard. A replicate dot or a whisker cap is centred and so is in neither flank; a real top rule is at the same row in both. Every bar here reads 0.0 px, which is why F-018's 15-of-60 failure cannot be present.

P8_S5_marker_centroid_equals_bbox_centre._what: S5 has no bars, so bar_top does not apply and a marker's value is its CENTROID. If the chroma mask were catching an overlapping label or a clipped marker the centroid would leave the bounding-box centre.

P9_corpus_overlap_full_inchikey._what: Report, do not act. Siblings in this run found 360/489, 246/580 and 11/104 members already present.

P10_linkage_is_a_carbonate_not_an_ester_._what: MASS CANNOT SEE CONNECTIVITY. P1-P4 would all pass on an ester bearing an extra oxygen elsewhere. 13C separates them: a dialkyl carbonate carbonyl is ~155 ppm and an aliphatic ester ~173, and this spectrum has one peak at 155.16 and nothing between 168 and 180. The two peaks at 52.93/52.67 are the authors' own stated evidence that the tails sit one per nitrogen rather than two on one.
